summary: Wheeler Real Estate Investment Trust filed an 8-K on June 19, 2026, announcing the engagement of CBRE's National Retail Partners to market 35 of its 59 properties (primarily retail shopping centers across 14 states) as a portfolio sale transaction. No price, premium, or timetable has been disclosed; the board has not yet approved any transaction. The filing is a preliminary, non-binding engagement with no definitive agreement. Watch for the launch of a formal sale process and any unsolicited bids; risk-arb depends on buyer interest and market conditions.
